---
title: "talatThaiR"
description: "ตลาดไท เพื่อดึงข้อมูลทางการเกษตรต่าง ๆ จากสำนักงานเศรษฐกิจการเกษตร (NABC)"
---

An R package for browsing Thai agricultural prices and indices from the National Agricultural Big Data Center (NABC) API, like a walk through a Thai market (ตลาด). It handles the HTTP requests and pagination for you and returns ready-to-use data frames.

[Package documentation](https://kanthjs.github.io/talatThaiR/){.btn-link-out target="_blank"} [GitHub](https://github.com/kanthjs/talatThaiR){.btn-link-out target="_blank"}

## Available data

- Commodity prices: daily, weekly, monthly
- Agricultural production index: monthly, quarterly, yearly
- Agricultural price index: monthly, quarterly, yearly

## Main functions

| Function | Returns |
|:--|:--|
| `get_daily_prices()` | Daily commodity prices |
| `get_weekly_prices()` | Weekly commodity prices |
| `get_monthly_prices()` | Monthly commodity prices |
| `get_production_index_month()` / `_quarter()` / `_year()` | Production index |
| `get_price_index_month()` / `_quarter()` / `_year()` | Price index |

Helper functions such as `show_daily_products()` and `show_index_groups()` list the valid product and category codes. Product names differ between the daily and weekly datasets, so check the list first.

## Install

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("kanthjs/talatThaiR")
```
